page.layout: One text column, full width, with the running head "De Duellis." at the top left and the page number "45" at the top right. No marginal notes. The catchword "Mili-" stands at the right below the last line.

main_text.p: Prudentis itaque ducis erit adolescentes quos laboribus bellicis sustinendis olim pares esse velit, quàm primùm rudi-mentis reddere assuetos bellicis. Nisi enim istis à teneris sint innutriti, ad duriora post-modum reperientur inepti. Quae initio sunt difficilia, si ac-cedat consuetudo; reddentur facilia; etiam tandem delecta-bunt. Exemplo erit Milo Cro-toniates, qui nisi vitulam primitus gestasset, nec taurum gestare potuisset. Et inter Ro-manos imperatores hoc nomine celebratus Caligula quod in castris natus esset & in patriis armis nutritus. Ut enim consuetudo sensim ac paulatim in-ducenda, ne subita gravem in corpore efficiat mutationem: Itaetiam ab ineunte aetate, & per vices exercitia habenda, ne si repente adhibeantur, ma-gnis periculis membra subja-ceant.

page.notes: The first word of the page is indented, so it opens a new paragraph and is not marked as a continuation. The whole page is one paragraph, because no later line is indented. The long s is printed as f in "adolefcentes", "esse", "gestasset" and "potuisset", and is transcribed as s. "Itaetiam" is printed with no space between the words and is copied as printed. The page number and running head are printed at the top, not in the text.
